scenarios.caution: Named component tests are not sufficient proof of actual triggers, production composition or recovery.

requirement_mapping.requirement: World state uses stable sections with explicit update semantics
A snapshot is valid only for its retained checkpoint baseline
World state and its items are recoverably committed together
Branch operations restore or reinitialize the correct baseline
Permission descriptions never grant execution authority
Frozen round inputs are not dynamic world state
Typed items preserve identity and trusted provenance
History persistence is lossless and distinct from display
Legacy revisions are adapted without rewriting authority
Authored and execution histories have separate authority
Continuation is scoped to an eligible execution branch
A compatibility bridge cannot create a second history authority
Provider requests use explicit protocol and capability contracts
Manual replay uses Focus checkpoints as the sole context authority
Policy authority survives provider role differences
Tool protocol remains under Focus execution authority
Structured output and modalities are validated after projection
Provider compaction cannot publish a Focus revision
All model roles use the declared projection boundary
Stream normalization preserves channel and item boundaries
Tool calls execute only after valid argument completion
Provider terminal status controls model attempt settlement
Partial audit cannot masquerade as replayable complete history
Usage reflects actual requests and distinguishes unavailable values
Existing display settlement and bounded rendering are preserved
Semantic history is a deterministic derived view
Selection eligibility applies across the entire indexing pipeline
Tool evidence retains its invocation context
Selected references remain available without repetitive extraction
Index compatibility includes semantic selection contracts
Semantic evidence remains resolvable to authoritative sources
Context assembly separates behavior and scoped inputs
Context is assembled according to role and ownership
Selected context bindings are immutable and attributable
Collaboration delivery is durable and deduplicated
Request context is auditable without another authority
Material and must-view behavior is preserved in actual requests

limitations: Full backend suite not rerun in this verification turn.
Earlier full backend run had 20 failures: 13 independently reproduced on HEAD and 7 corrected with focused retests; this is not a fresh full-suite pass.
OpenAI live smoke and interactive Electron E2E were not run; prior DeepSeek smoke evidence is retained, not rerun.
Memory-checkpointer reproductions prove middleware/reader/compiler behavior; they do not simulate process death on a live production instance.
